title: PuckIQ — Bench Games v2

comfy.prompt: Use the supplied image as the exact first frame. One continuous three-second macro sports-commercial shot at ice level in a dark hockey arena. A scuffed black rubber puck rests low in the portrait frame on scratched wet ice, rim-lit in white and deep red. The camera slowly dollies closer and subtly tracks right, giving realistic parallax through foreground ice crystals. The puck glides only a few centimeters forward, maintaining its rigid circular shape and textured black rubber surface. Fine cold vapor drifts sideways behind it and tiny ice crystals sparkle in the stadium lights. The upper half remains dark open space for typography. Restrained physical motion, crisp photorealism, hard specular highlights, shallow depth of field, premium sports-ad lighting. Quiet ice scrape, no speech or music. One shot, no cuts, no new objects, no letters, no logos, no melting or deformation.
